# Animation runtime

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, pinned and downloaded from cdnjs on 15 October 2026:

- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.13.0/gsap.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.13.0/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Original distribution headers are retained. Local delivery avoids an extra animation CDN connection. The site remains readable if these files fail. Calendly and Vimeo load only on explicit visitor action.

Implementation references: [GSAP ScrollTrigger documentation](https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/) and [Calendly embedding options](https://calendly.com/help/embed-options-overview).
